[package]
name = "labwired-wasm"
version.workspace = true
edition = "2021"
license.workspace = true
publish = false

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

# wasm-pack's default release pass is a bare `wasm-opt -O`, which (a) does NOT
# strip the DWARF debug info the workspace `debug = true` profile bakes in — the
# shipped bg.wasm was 4.5 MB, roughly half of it debug sections that the browser
# downloads and never uses — and (b) rejects the bulk-memory/simd128 opcodes we
# now emit (see .cargo/config.toml). This override strips debug/producers and
# opts at -Oz (size) so the content-hashed engine stays under Cloudflare Pages'
# 25 MiB per-file limit (26214400 bytes) with margin as the simulator grows,
# while still allowing the post-MVP features. Keep the feature flags here in sync with
# the target-feature list in .cargo/config.toml.
[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = ["-Oz", "--strip-debug", "--strip-producers", "--enable-bulk-memory", "--enable-simd", "--enable-nontrapping-float-to-int"]

[dependencies]
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.92"
# #124 Phase 4: js-sys exposes `js_sys::WebAssembly::{Module, Instance}` used
# by the browser-side JIT prototype in `src/jit_browser.rs`. Already a
# transitive dep of `serde-wasm-bindgen`; pinning it here makes the direct
# usage visible at the dep boundary.
js-sys = "0.3"
# Phase 2B.1 (issue #192): the event-driven peripheral scheduler. This
# feature is also enabled by default in the CLI. Core-only test lanes still
# need `--features event-scheduler` to exercise it (see the classic-ESP32 gate in
# `crates/core/tests/esp32_classic_walk_differential.rs`).
#
# The comment that used to live here claimed the browser's ESP32-classic bus had
# "every peripheral migrated or inert", so the per-cycle-walk deletion was free
# (~2.4x, 1.48 -> 3.57 MIPS on the epaper firmware). That was NOT true: uart0/1/2
# and i2c0 are still legacy-walk models, and the classic bus asserted the
# walk-deleted flag by hand rather than deriving it — which starved the UART of
# ticks and livelocked arduino-esp32's TX-FIFO wait loop. The flag is derived
# now, so classic ESP32 keeps its walk (and loses that throughput) until those
# models are genuinely migrated. Walk deletion still applies on every bus that
# actually earns it (C3, S3, nRF, RP2040, STM32).
labwired-core = { path = "../core", features = ["event-scheduler", "jit-framework"] }
labwired-config = { path = "../config" }
labwired-loader = { path = "../loader" }
cortex-m = "0.7"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
serde_yaml = "0.9"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6"
labwired-gdbstub = { path = "../gdbstub" }
gdbstub = "0.7"
gdbstub_arch = "0.3"
anyhow = "1.0"
tracing = "0.1"
